title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96 > adobe audition cc > fission > xACT flac
source: source: aud cassette master taped by Doug Lamarre  sennheiser 441's > sony d5, maxell xl-II90's

ai_review.summary: Immersive audience field recording captures the Coliseum’s jubilant sing‑along, though the band is less crisp than other sources.
ai_review.review: The review praises the overwhelming sense of joy and the massive crowd singing in perfect unison, describing the ambience as “off the scale” and ideal for feeling like you’re in the middle of the arena. While the recording is an audience (field) capture that sacrifices some clarity of the band, it is still deemed a fantastic document of the event’s energy.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed, enthusiastic review highlights high show energy and an engaging audience recording; lack of band clarity prevents a top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Field‑recorded ambience is excellent and immersive, but the band's sound is less clear than typical soundboard sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist details provided; review focuses on overall crowd enthusiasm.
